title: Performance issue with slow sorting algorithm
body:
## Bug Description

The application is slow when sorting large lists. It takes too long to sort 10,000 items.

## Error Message

No error, just slow performance.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Create a list with 10,000 random numbers
2. Call the sort function
3. It takes a long time

## Expected Behavior

It should be faster.

## Actual Behavior

It's slow.

## Additional Context

The code is somewhere in the project. Maybe in a utils file or something. Not sure exactly where. It might be using bubble sort or something inefficient. Or maybe it's the database? Could also be a network issue.

Would be great if someone could just make it faster overall.
